title.en: AN ACT DECLARING THE RANCHERIA OF TUBO TO BE A PART OF THE PROVINCE OF ABRA.
title.orig: AN ACT DECLARING THE RANCHERIA OF TUBO TO BE A PART OF THE PROVINCE OF ABRA.
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố Rancheria của Tubo là một phần của tỉnh Abra
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้รันเชเรียทูโบเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของจังหวัดอับรา
title.id: Undang-Undang menyatakan Rancheria Tubo sebagai bagian dari Provinsi Abra
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan Rancheria Tubo sebagai sebahagian daripada Wilayah Abra

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_00293_1901_html.txt

text.en:
The rancheria of Tubo, lying between the Provinces of Lepanto and Abra, is hereby declared to be
a part of the Province of Abra.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 5, 1901.
